parsed.why: No national criminalisation or facility ban, but documented male-dorm head-shaving custody, patterned transfemicide flagged by rights commission, police arresting Pride participants, stalled equality bill and unenforced local dress ordinances; protections remain patchwork.

Recurrent state raids on queer gatherings with beatings, forced examinations and imprisonment (2017, continuing 2023), no legal protection, last-place regional ranking, 77% hostile media and a murder with inadequate investigation; tier-2 state targeting.

Strong visitor-facing framework — self-ID recognition, X markers, marriage, care restored by court, improved custody — but marked deterioration: record 227 SOGI hate crimes, abolished anti-discrimination agency, activists describe vulnerability and weak enforcement.

Foreign documents and X markers accepted, goods-and-services protection in every state, hate-crime law, documented arrests of a luring network and conviction machinery; residual risks are far-right rise, undetailed prison rules and gay-targeted, not trans-specific, violence.

Universal airport exposure: appearance-passport matching, genital X-rays, refusal and deportation over a decade. Presentation criminalised with documented visitor imprisonment, head-shaving and hormone confiscation; no recognition, no organisations, detention abuse and censorship.
